definitions: A 1994 American drama film written and directed by Frank Darabont, based on the 1982 Stephen King novella Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption.
A critically acclaimed and commercially successful film often cited as one of the greatest movies ever made, known for its themes of hope, friendship, and redemption.
examples: Many consider The Shawshank Redemption a masterpiece.
The Shawshank Redemption was nominated for seven Academy Awards.
I watched The Shawshank Redemption again last night.
